epaPlastic.note: Mechanical recycling predominates, but variable plastic inputs can yield inconsistent material properties.

waData.note: State waste and recovery datasets are available for investigation; local stream volumes have not been extracted.

waTires.note: Waste-tire collection, transport and storage are regulated; local eligibility must be reviewed before activity.

epaTire.note: Crumb rubber production separates rubber from reinforcing steel and fabric; product exposure and environmental performance need application-specific review.

arsOrchard.note: A four-year whole-orchard recycling study examined soil carbon, greenhouse gases and almond productivity; transfer to Yakima crops is unverified.

arsBiochar.note: Biomass-derived biochar is studied for stabilization of biomass carbon; local net benefit is not established.

doeHeat.note: Commercial waste heat recovery exists; material and maintenance constraints can restrict adoption.

rows.question: Can segregated discarded agricultural polymers become durable non-safety-critical manufacturing feedstock?
rows.next: Obtain polymer identification, actual available volumes, contamination data, recovery yield and target product requirements; compare against virgin resin and existing disposal.

rows.question: Which permitted recovery pathways preserve rubber and steel value while controlling particle release and exposure?
rows.next: Identify authorized facilities and documented output specifications; compare retreading eligibility, material reuse and end-of-life alternatives.

rows.question: Can clean orchard residues produce useful materials or stable carbon outcomes relative to direct orchard recycling?
rows.next: Obtain actual clean dry biomass availability, competing uses, qualified conversion partner data, emissions and soil suitability; preserve a no-conversion comparator.
rows.potentialOffer: Orchard residue feasibility and baseline study

rows.question: Which industrial waste heat streams have compatible local heat demand and viable economics?
rows.next: Obtain measured heat source/sink profiles, coincidence, uptime, constraints and independent engineering review. Existing screening engine does not yet support this stream.
